BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to personal use shellfish licenses; and amendingRCW 77.32.520.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 77.32.520 and 2000 c 107 s 27 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A personal use shellfish and seaweed license or a razor clamlicense is required for all persons other than residents ornonresidents under ((fifteen)) eighteen years of age to fish for, take,dig for, or possess seaweed or shellfish for personal use from statewaters or offshore waters including national park beaches. A razorclam license allows a person to harvest razor clams only. (2) The fees for annual personal use shellfish and seaweed licensesare: (a) For a resident ((fifteen)) eighteen years of age or older,seven dollars; (b) For a nonresident ((fifteen)) eighteen years of age or older,twenty dollars; and (c) For a senior, five dollars. p. 1 SB 6282 (3) The ((license)) fee for a ((twoday personal use shellfish andseaweed)) razor clam license is six dollars for residents ((or)) andfifteen dollars for nonresidents ((fifteen)) eighteen years of age orolder. (4) The personal use shellfish and seaweed license or razor clamlicense shall be visible on the licensee while harvesting shellfish orseaweed.
